transcript.en: First of all I'd just like to say, Cristina and Ibrahim, that I really enjoyed watching your video about student life last week, and I could see that the rest of the group did too.
transcript.zh: 首先，我想对克里斯蒂娜和易卜拉欣说，我真的很喜欢你们上周做的关于学生生活的视频，我看到其他组的同学也这么想。

transcript.en: You did really well, and I hope that you got a lot out of it.
transcript.zh: 你们做的很好，我希望你们从中学到了很多。

transcript.en: I'd like to use this tutorial as a feedback session, where you reflect on the experience of doing the project.
transcript.zh: 我想用这次辅导作为反馈课，让你们思考一下制作的经历。

transcript.en: So Cristina, I was wondering, what did you enjoy most about making the video?
transcript.zh: 那么克里斯蒂娜，我想知道在制作视频中，你最喜欢的是什么？

transcript.en: I liked using the camera.
transcript.zh: 我喜欢使用摄影机

transcript.en: Is it the first time you've operated one like that?
transcript.zh: 这是你第一次操纵这种摄影机吗

transcript.en: Yes, it is.
transcript.zh: 是的

transcript.en: Well the results were very good!
transcript.zh: 结果非常棒

transcript.en: Anything else?
transcript.zh: 还有什么吗

transcript.en: I also enjoyed visiting one of the British students we filmed.
transcript.zh: 我还喜欢拜访我们拍摄的其中一位英国学生

transcript.en: I'd never been inside a British home before.
transcript.zh: 我之前从未去过英国人的家里

transcript.en: OK Cristina, thanks.
transcript.zh: 好的 Christina,谢谢

transcript.en: What about you, Ibrahim?
transcript.zh: 你呢？Ibrahim?

transcript.en: What did you enjoy?
transcript.zh: 你喜欢什么

transcript.en: Well for me it was a very good chance to get to know students who are on other courses, because everyone in our group is studying English, and we don't usually have much to do with the rest of the college.
transcript.zh: 对我来说，这是了解其他学科的学生的好机会，因为我们组的所有人都是学英语的，我们通常和大学的其他人没什么联系。

transcript.en: Yes, good.
transcript.zh: 是的

transcript.en: Do you think you'll maintain the contact now?
transcript.zh: 很好，你现在还和他们保持联系吗，

transcript.en: I hope so.
transcript.zh: 我希望是

transcript.en: I've invited three of them to have dinner with me next week.
transcript.zh: 我邀请了他们中的三个人下周和我一起吃晚餐

transcript.en: Great!
transcript.zh: 好极了

transcript.en: If you haven't decided what to make yet I can tell you they'll love trying Arab dishes.
transcript.zh: 如果你还没决定做什么，我告诉你他们喜欢吃阿拉伯菜，

transcript.en: And of course, it's good for your English too.
transcript.zh: 当然，这对你的英语也有好处。

transcript.en: Cristina, what did you find?
transcript.zh: 克里斯蒂娜

transcript.en: What was the most useful aspect of the project from the point of view of the English practice?
transcript.zh: 你发现了什么，从英语学习的角度，这个项目最有益的方面是什么，

transcript.en: I think, when we were being shown how to edit the film, we had to follow the instructions.
transcript.zh: 我想当我们学习如何剪辑电影的时候，我们不得不按照说明书做。

transcript.en: And that was very good practice for me.
transcript.zh: 这对我来说是很好的练习

transcript.en: And I also learned some technical words that I hadn't heard before.
transcript.zh: 另外我还学会了许多从前不知道的专业词汇

transcript.en: Hmm, what about you Ibrahim?
transcript.zh: 你呢，易卜拉欣？

transcript.en: What was the most useful for your English?
transcript.zh: 对你的英语最有益处的地方是什么？

transcript.en: It was listening to the British students, because they don't speak as slowly as most of the tutors on our course.
transcript.zh: 是听英国学生说话，因为他们不会像我们课堂上的多数导师一样说的那么慢。

transcript.en: I think they speak at natural speed, so it forces me to get used to it.
transcript.zh: 他们的语速自然，所以我得强迫自己习惯它，

transcript.en: And they use a lot of slang.
transcript.zh: 并且他们使用很多的俚语

transcript.en: So you learned some new words which will be useful?
transcript.zh: 所以你学到了很多有用的词汇

transcript.en: Yes.
transcript.zh: 是的

transcript.en: Good.
transcript.zh: 很好

transcript.en: I'm glad it helped.
transcript.zh: 我很高兴这对你有帮助

transcript.en: Well, we've talked a little bit about enjoyment, and about language practice.
transcript.zh: 我们说了一些有趣的事和语言学习的方面

transcript.en: Were there any other benefits?
transcript.zh: 还有其他的好处吗

transcript.en: What else did you feel you'd learnt from the project?
transcript.zh: 从这次的项目上你们还学到了什么

transcript.en: Was it useful in other ways?
transcript.zh: 在其他方面有帮助吗

transcript.en: Yes, well firstly, I learned how to use a video camera.
transcript.zh: 是的，首先我学会了如何使用摄影机。

transcript.en: And also, I think I really learned a lot about working together with other people.
transcript.zh: 另外我学了很多关于如何与他人共事

transcript.en: I've never done anything with a group before, and we had to find ways of cooperating, erm, and compromising, and sometimes persuading people, when they don't agree with you.
transcript.zh: 我从前从没和一组人共事过，我们要找到合作的方式，相互妥协或者说服别人接受你的意见。

transcript.en: Yes, that is a very useful experience, I know.
transcript.zh: 是的，这是非常有用的经验。

transcript.en: What about you, Ibrahim?
transcript.zh: 你怎么想，Ibrahim?

transcript.en: Well, I think I learnt a lot about how important editing is.
transcript.zh: 我想我了解到了剪辑的重要性

transcript.en: When you're filming you think that everything's going to be interesting, but in fact we cut around half of it in the end, and then it was much better.
transcript.zh: 当你拍摄的时候，你觉得所有事情都很有趣。但是事实上，在最后我们删去了一半左右的素材，这样看起来才更好。

transcript.en: Good.
transcript.zh: 很好

transcript.en: Well, one last thing I'd like to ask.
transcript.zh: 还有最后一个问题

transcript.en: What mistakes do you think you, as a group that is, made?
transcript.zh: 你认为在这其中你犯了什么错

transcript.en: I mean, to put it another way, if you had to do it all over again, is there anything you'd do differently?
transcript.zh: 我是说，换一个角度，如果要你重做一遍，你会在某件事上做出不同的决定吗？

transcript.en: We didn't plan very well.
transcript.zh: 我们计划的不是很好

transcript.en: For example, we didn't decide on dates when we'd complete each separate step of the project, and we should have agreed about that in the beginning, because we were always late with everything!
transcript.zh: 例如，我们没有制定每个步骤的截至日期，我们本该在一开始就确定好，因为后来所有事总是慢半拍。

transcript.en: Right.
transcript.zh: 好的

transcript.en: Anything else?
transcript.zh: 还有吗

transcript.en: I think we should have tried to experiment more with the camera.
transcript.zh: 我想我们应该多尝试一下摄影机的功能

transcript.en: I mean with angles, and the focus and that kind of thing.
transcript.zh: 我的意思是角度、焦距之类的。

transcript.en: So you should have been more ambitious?
transcript.zh: 所以你觉得你应该更有点野心

transcript.en: Do you agree, Ibrahim?
transcript.zh: 你同意吗？易卜拉欣

transcript.en: Not really.
transcript.zh: 不同意

transcript.en: In fact, I think we were too ambitious.
transcript.zh: 事实上，我觉得我们太有野心了，

transcript.en: We were inexperienced, and we didn't have a lot of time, and we tried to do too much, to make a long film.
transcript.zh: 我们没有经验，又没有很多时间。我们要尝试很多去制作一个长篇电影。

transcript.en: Next time I would make a shorter one and try to get quality better.
transcript.zh: 下次我要制作一个短片，质量上也要更好一些。

transcript.en: Well, that's very interesting.
transcript.zh: 很有意思

transcript.en: Next semester we will be doing another video project - with a different content, of course - but you'll have an opportunity to put into practice what you've learnt this time.
transcript.zh: 下学期我们将做一个不同内容的新视频项目。但是你们有机会把这次的经验学以致用。

transcript.en: Do you have any ideas about...
transcript.zh: 你们有想关于...
